verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted, single-binary runtime (docker run locally, no GPU required) that lets users run models entirely on their own infrastructure, which implicitly gives full control over where data resides. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing multi-region deployment, data-residency guarantees, or configuration for choosing storage location beyond 'run it yourself'. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, any built-in region-selection or compliance controls, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
